purpose: Prevent repeated learning-plane cost storms, identity spoofing, duplicate context rebuilds and stale component identity while preserving append-only learning.

BG166.role: Error & Learning Ledger Writer; fingerprint dedupe and refresh reservation owner

BG167.role: Shared Multi-Agent Team Context projection builder; privileged expensive refresh target

BG168.role: Multi-Agent Outcome & Learning Router; materiality/classification and fail-open dispatch

BG202.role: Shared Team Context Cache Reader; canonical ordinary read path

invariants.rule: User-, agent-, LLM- or module-supplied identity fields such as agent_id, owner, role or source never independently authorize privileged writes, rebuilds or actions.

BG167 expensive rebuild requires the canonical BG166 refresh route plus a private capability. The capability value must never be persisted in documentation, learning payloads, logs intended for shared memory, or chat-learning artifacts.

BG166 reserves at most one BG167 refresh per UTC hour using bucket YYYYMMDDHH and window_seconds=3600. Historical 10-second or 1-minute wording is stale metadata and must not be implemented as runtime policy.
Ordinary shared-context reads use BG202 and the dedicated cache. Read requests must not execute Notion projection or cache-write rebuild modules.
Learning/governance cost is part of GREEN. Duplicate or equivalent learning events must not cause repeated expensive context rebuilds.

When Make reports organization/team pause from operations or data-transfer limits, stop proof/retry bursts, keep open runtime obligations explicit and continue independent repository/documentation work.
Connector mutation acknowledgements such as applied/success are not authoritative configuration evidence. Read-after-write/read-after-error decides current state.

known_failures.prevention: One canonical reservation owner, cache-only ordinary reads, fail-closed privileged refresh boundary and bounded proof runs.

known_failures.root_cause: BG167 trusted request text containing agent_id=BG166 and mode=refresh as authorization, allowing a direct caller to impersonate BG166.
known_failures.prevention: Self-asserted identity is insufficient; require non-public/private authority evidence in the canonical route.

known_failures.root_cause: A Make patch response reported applied while direct read-back still showed stale module label metadata.
known_failures.prevention: Never derive runtime semantics from mutation acknowledgement or stale UI labels; use read-back plus mapper/filter/runtime evidence.

runtime_green_acceptance: A spoof/direct BG167 request without valid private authority stops before expensive projection modules.
Exactly one reservation-winning canonical BG166 request may cause a BG167 rebuild in a UTC-hour window.
Additional material learnings in the same UTC hour persist while refresh returns coalesced/no-action.
Ordinary shared-context reads execute through BG202 cache-only path.
Measured BG167 executions, credits and operations remain materially below the 23-run/192-credit/128-operation incident baseline.
No scenario is declared VERIFIED_RUNTIME_GREEN solely from CONFIGURED, PATCHED, applied, cached output or historical success evidence.
